obligations.source_text: The waist, hips, both thighs, both leg openings, and every garment hem must remain fully visible and inspectable.

bindings.shared_waist_system_phrase: one shared athletic waist system supports both short layers
bindings.loose_outer_shell_phrase: a loose outer running-short shell forms its own two-leg silhouette
bindings.separate_fitted_inner_shorts_phrase: separately fitted inner shorts form two readable leg openings
bindings.two_distinct_hem_levels_phrase: outer-shell hems and longer inner-short hems remain simultaneously visible
bindings.brief_liner_color_block_confound_control: a brief liner or single-layer color block cannot substitute for fitted inner shorts
